key_concepts: Biodiversity is the number and variety of life on Earth
Biodiversity has genetic, species, and ecosystem diversity
Genetic diversity is the variation of genes within species
Species diversity is the variety and abundance of species in a region
Ecosystem diversity is the variation among organisms in different physical settings
A population is organisms of the same species living in the same region
Biodiversity index is calculated as total number of different species divided by total num
